hypothesis: Publishing each prefill chunk calls touch_path on the full prompt ancestry. After a previous touch, that exact tip-to-root chain forms one contiguous range in recency order. If a later traversal reaches the saved tip, moving that range to newest must produce the same recency permutation as the original one-entry-at-a-time loop. Exact token keys and per-block refcounts unchanged.
correctness: Compare the complete forward and reverse order with a reference list after extensions, switches to other branches and ancestors, intervening insertions, evictions, entry-ID reuse and clear. Run the full scheduler tests. Compare actual two-generation server inputs, output token IDs, hit count and total eviction count under repeated prompts, unrelated prompts and cache churn. No numerical or admission behavior change is intended.
performance: Time accumulating publication recency at 8K,32K,128K, chunk=32 or 256 tokens, and switching between independent paths, against original source. Report warmed CPU timings and code conditions. GPU round trip may be dominated by model compute; report separately. Avoid claiming end-to-end improvement from microbenchmarks.
